g.text: F2/F5 gap: layers observed the camera, not daemon components — closed by fail-fast socket bind + degraded dimension (socket-accept, web-server, extdep:*)
Is the process alive and looping?
systemd Type=notify | WATCHDOG=1 every poll tick | Restart=on-failure
